---
id: log-export
title: "Exports your activity logs"
description: "Downloads every active log belonging to the authenticated user, oldest first by created_at then id. Deleted logs, other users' logs and contest attachments are excluded, including for administrators. JSON contains a logs array. CSV uses the same twelve fields in the documented column order, UTF-8 with a BOM, and LF line endings. Nullable CSV values are empty cells. Text cells beginning with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return are prefixed with an apostrophe to prevent spreadsheet formulas; JSON text is unchanged. Tags are sorted alphabetically and joined with ', ' in CSV. Tags containing commas are ambiguous in CSV; use JSON for a lossless export."

Downloads every active log belonging to the authenticated user, oldest first by created_at then id. Deleted logs, other users' logs and contest attachments are excluded, including for administrators. JSON contains a logs array. CSV uses the same twelve fields in the documented column order, UTF-8 with a BOM, and LF line endings. Nullable CSV values are empty cells. Text cells beginning with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return are prefixed with an apostrophe to prevent spreadsheet formulas; JSON text is unchanged. Tags are sorted alphabetically and joined with ", " in CSV. Tags containing commas are ambiguous in CSV; use JSON for a lossless export.
